verdict.rationale: Speechmatics has a dedicated first-party Diarization feature page stating it separates a transcript into distinct speakers or channels so you can see who said what, which is the core of this story. The evidence is a single summary line, though, with no detail on how the request is made or how labels appear in the output. Missing for 10: documented request configuration (e.g. diarization parameter in the job or stream config), example of speaker-label output format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
